title: Multi-node joint optimisation: supply temperature, flow distribution and placement, 1 to 16 nodes
research_question: With a shared plant, unequal branch hydraulics and series cold plates, does jointly choosing the supply temperature, the valve openings and the placement lower facility energy per on-time job compared with independent control (fixed cold supply, equal valves, least-loaded placement), and does the benefit hold from 1 to 16 nodes?
hypothesis: Scales 1 node (8 GPUs), 4 nodes (1 rack), 16 nodes (4 racks); series pairs; branch resistance spread 1.0 across nodes (none for one node); load 0.75; ambient 20 and 30 C; NTU plant; 2 h + 30 min drain. Arms: independent = supply fixed at 25 C, equal valves, least_loaded; warm = warmest-safe supply (3 K margin), equal valves, least_loaded; warm_valves = warm + heat-proportional valves; joint = warm_valves + thermal_credit. Paired by seed. H1: joint's facility energy per on-time job is at least 3% lower than independent's at every scale and ambient (95% CI below 0). H2: joint's on-time fraction is within 1 percentage point of independent's at every scale and ambient (seed means). H3: the joint-vs-independent energy benefit at 16 nodes is at least the 1-node benefit minus 1 percentage point, at both ambients. H4: at 16 nodes, warm_valves has lower energy per on-time job than warm (95% CI below 0) at both ambients. Descriptive: mean supply, fan, chiller and pump energy, chip-seconds above target, throttling.
null_hypothesis: Joint control does not lower facility energy per on-time job relative to independent control.
controlled_variables: identical job streams per (scale, ambient, seed) across arms
evaluation_criteria: Paired relative differences per seed, mean and 95% t-CI; seed means for fractions.
randomization: Job streams drawn per (condition topology size, seed); arms share them.
measurement_boundary: Simulated facility electricity of the cluster (IT / conversion, pumps, fans, chiller).
known_limitations: Instant plant (no supply lag; E015 covers lag on one node); warmest-safe supply uses measured state with a fixed 3 K margin; valve model has no actuator dynamics; pump flow fixed; illustrative topology; leakage and plant parameters are registry placeholders (class F).
known_confounders: job streams differ between scales (different GPU counts), so scales are compared through paired within-scale ratios only
disclosure: Before registration: E018's design, unit-test runs of the facility simulator, and E012/E021 expectations that warmer supply saves fan and chiller energy but adds leakage. No E020 cell was run before registration.
data_collection: Append-only store; per-run config and code hashes; time series for seed 0.
statistics: Paired by seed; d = (A - B)/B; mean with 95% t-CI.
